title: Personal health record aggregator
summary: All your medical records from every provider in one app.
whyTempting: Records are scattered and patients are frustrated.
whyItFails: Interoperability. Providers' systems don't share data easily. Low urgency. People only need records occasionally. Government and platform competition. Public health records and Apple Health exist.
whatWouldChange: Mandated interoperability standards (e.g. FHIR APIs) actually enforced.

attempts.notes: Web-based personal health record; closed November 2019 and remaining data deleted.

attempts.outcome: Shut down after failing to gain adoption

reasons.detail: Interoperability: Providers' systems don't share data easily.
Low urgency: People only need records occasionally.
Government and platform competition: Public health records and Apple Health exist.
